beats.headline: Five landings in a row
beats.text: Carl, Katia and Donut leap from the wicker basket as the Wasteland's guns smash into it, and as Carl tumbles through the air, Donut cannot remember when to drink it. Now! Mordecai, who brewed the three doses, had warned they would not like it. A crocodilian crawler alchemist devised it long ago while falling down a pit; it combines a potion from the breeding of rock buffalos with one like Katia's Crowd Blast, and it only works above two hundred kilometers an hour. Five seconds to impact become two, the ground softens, and they slam it like meteors, rise fifteen feet and slam it again. Five times. Then Carl is walking on air: he has broken through the necropolis roof.

beats.headline: Better than Half Splat
beats.text: Each of their Silver Skydiver's boxes holds three potions of Half Splat. Mordecai tells them to keep those in the hotlist until they can get a real Featherfall: they keep a crawler from dying of falling damage, but leave them at five percent health. They're still better than that Dolores Doesn't Splat potion, Carl grumbles. Hey now, says Mordecai. That potion is genius. It may not be pleasant, but his health was still at a hundred percent when he landed.
